description: Source code implementing 64-QAM demodulation with SIMD optimizations (AVX512, AVX2, NEON) for soft bit likelihood ratio calculation, including interval-based LLR computation and vectorized data reorganization.

methods.name: demod_QAM64_avx512
methods.description: Vectorized demodulation function using AVX512 to compute 192 LLRs from 32 symbols.

methods.name: demod_QAM64_avx2
methods.description: Vectorized demodulation function using AVX2 to compute 96 LLRs from 16 symbols.

methods.name: demod_QAM64_neon
methods.description: Vectorized demodulation function using NEON to compute 48 LLRs from 8 symbols.

methods.name: demod_64QAM_symbol_01
methods.description: Computes LLR for bits 0 and 1 of a 64-QAM symbol given value and reciprocal noise variance.

methods.name: demod_64QAM_symbol_23
methods.description: Computes LLR for bits 2 and 3 of a 64-QAM symbol given value and reciprocal noise variance.

methods.name: demod_64QAM_symbol_45
methods.description: Computes LLR for bits 4 and 5 of a 64-QAM symbol given value and reciprocal noise variance.

methods.name: ocudu::demodulate_soft_QAM64
methods.description: Main function to demodulate a span of 64-QAM symbols into soft LLRs, utilizing SIMD optimizations.
